title: John Paul II establishes Vatican observatory for UFO research
summary: Kiran Ilum Xenov tells of John Paul II establishes Vatican observatory for UFO research, about Late 1980s at Vatican, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I think it was during his time in the late 80s. The pope signed a decree and a special observatory was established right there inside the Vatican.

plain: Kiran Ilum Xenov, a former president of a republic inside Russia, says that in the late 1980s Pope John Paul II signed a decree setting up a special observatory right inside the Vatican, the seat of the Catholic Church. As he tells it, the observatory was meant for looking into UFOs. If true, it would mean the Church's leadership took the subject seriously enough to study it.
